about: Display names a Mob refuses (SOCIAL-SPEC P3). Matching is on the name folded to lower-case letters. 'contains' terms are refused anywhere in the name with spaces, dots, apostrophes and hyphens removed; they are long or unambiguous enough not to sit inside a real name. 'words' are refused only as a whole word of the name, because they are short or are also parts of real names (Randip, Rapeti, Mobina). Moderators extend this list; a member's report is the backstop.
